verdict.rationale: CDP offers a few built-in event-triggered automations: deposit destinations auto-credit an account when funds arrive, with optional auto-liquidation that converts USDC to USD. Webhooks deliver real-time event notifications, including multi-address wallet activity subscriptions, but the user must build the action logic themselves. There is no general user-defined rules engine. Missing for 10: a general rule/trigger builder for arbitrary event-to-action automations, documentation of configurable conditions beyond auto-liquidation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
